name: fix-firearms-ranger-offhand
about: Issue #16: a Ranger with a Service Pistol in the main hand and a hand crossbow in the off hand. The pistol never fired for another class: the clip was filled and reloaded only for the Firearms Specialist (IsFirearms), so it stayed empty. Now the clip goes with the gun (UsesGuns). Checks: no clip without a gun; the clip fills in town and is full on floor 1; the pistol hurts a breakable target dummy and spends rounds, the crossbow hurts it and spends none; an emptied clip reloads on the next trigger pull. Shot: ranger-guns.

steps.name: a Ranger's pistol and hand crossbow
